analysis:
The two units are head-text excerpts of docs/architecture/inference.md (lines 3593-4073). The visible patch changes only the date header and some documentation text in the pair-policy section; the changed ranges (5253-5258, 5379-5389) fall outside the supplied excerpts, and the patch excerpt is truncated. This is documentation-only, so no code, authorization, attestation, encryption or billing behavior changes in the reviewed units.

I checked the described behavior against the threat model for contradictions. The link, share and served-speed probe files are described as owner-only files under ~/.darkbloom/cluster. The sealed all-sum is AES-256-GCM, and a peer piece that fails to open fails the request. GLM TP prefix entries are scoped per tenant partition (prefixScope/prefixDiskScope) and kept in the encrypted SSD tier, which is consistent with T-041 on salt scoping and the HMAC lookup tags. The tensor-parallel media path sends GLM media bytes from the leader to rank 0 only, and digests to rank 1. Rank environment is an allowlist, and the diagnostic env switches are not forwarded by an installed owner.

No security regression or invalidated threat assumption is visible in these excerpts. Remaining questions for integration: (1) The unseen 5253-5258 and 5379-5389 changes describe the resident-assistant evidence digest being folded into resourcePolicySHA256 and the Qwen27 assistant text. They are out of my supplied view, and the claims about approval binding should be checked against code. (2) The doc says the GLM TP vision/media path reuses the product's bounded ingest and caps; this is a documentation claim that is not verified here. (3) The statements about prefix SSD tenant partitioning rely on source code that was not supplied.
